downregulation of short-term neuronal synaptic plasticity
narrow: inhibition of short-term neuronal synaptic plasticity

definition: A process that decreases short-term neuronal synaptic plasticity, the ability of neuronal synapses to change in the short-term as circumstances require. Short-term neuronal synaptic plasticity generally involves increasing or decreasing synaptic sensitivity.
label: negative regulation of short-term neuronal synaptic plasticity
